query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.finalAmount,
  SUM(si.quantity * si.unitPrice) as items_total,
  s.finalAmount - SUM(si.quantity * si.unitPrice) as difference
FROM sales s
JOIN sale_items si ON s.id = si.saleId
WHERE MONTH(CONVERT_TZ(s.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 12 
  AND YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(s.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 2025
  AND s.status != 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY s.id, s.finalAmount
HAVING ABS(s.finalAmount - SUM(si.quantity * si.unitPrice)) > 0.01
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 20;
